gaps.quote: returns each record extracted by the correction to its hole
gaps.note: The page never says what the correction is, and it neither explains nor links it, so the reader cannot tell which records are extracted or why their holes are exceptional.

gaps.quote: the integers the rectangular routine handles
gaps.note: The rectangular routine is named but not explained or linked, so the reader cannot tell what integers it handles or why they are bounded by A_rect.

gaps.quote: Changing chunk $h$ by $q'_h - q_h$ with the others fixed changes the rank by $(q'_h - q_h)\sigma_h$, and these changes add.
gaps.note: The page defines the stride as the amount the rank changes but never shows why the rank changes by exactly the stride per unit of a chunk, for instance by stating that stream order enumerates addresses in mixed-radix order. The linear formula for rank(q') is therefore asserted, not checkable.

The page asserts that the rank key fits in A_rect bits but does not show that destination ranks are integers the rectangular routine handles, so the claimed bound and the at most A_rect passes that follow from it cannot be checked.

gaps.quote: the destinations of these records are exactly the addresses of $B$
gaps.note: This follows only from the definition of the correction, which the page does not give, so the reader cannot check that the destinations are exactly the exceptional addresses.
